```{python}
import inspect

import pypanelsim as pps


def show_signature(object_):
    print(f"{object_.__name__}{inspect.signature(object_)}")
```

## FTestEventStudy Lepskii draft

```{python}
show_signature(pps.LepskiiPanelConfig)
show_signature(pps.lepskii_design)
show_signature(pps.lepskii_profiles)
print(pps.available_lepskii_designs())
```

The configuration stores panel dimensions, nine adoption periods, uneven
cohort shares, and the untreated-outcome noise law. The factory returns a
reusable `PanelSimulator`. The profile function returns immutable
adoption-period-to-path mappings.

## ATT-DML

```{python}
show_signature(pps.ATTDMConditionalConfig)
show_signature(pps.ATTDMLatentConfig)
show_signature(pps.ATTDMClusteredConfig)
show_signature(pps.att_dml_design)
print(pps.available_att_dml_designs())
```

The factory validates the configuration type for the selected design family.
The conditional design has a separate `treated_baseline_shift` switch for the
executable-code and manuscript laws.

## Regression compression

```{python}
show_signature(pps.RegressionCompressionConfig)
show_signature(pps.regression_compression_design)
show_signature(pps.AnscombePanelConfig)
show_signature(pps.anscombe_design)
print(pps.available_anscombe_designs())
```

The main design supports `constant`, `linear`, `concave`,
`positive_then_negative`, `exponential`, `sinusoidal`, and `random_walk`
effects. The Anscombe design names are `zero`, `unit`, `time`, and
`cohort_time`.

## gsynth2 composite

```{python}
show_signature(pps.GSynthCompositeConfig)
show_signature(pps.gsynth_composite_design)
```

The four component weights must be finite, nonnegative, and not all zero. The
configuration normalizes them before construction.
